comparisons.peer_topic: Income Tax Provision and Effective Rate
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 with a 19% effective tax rate, compared to a $346 million benefit and (68%) rate in 2023. The 2024 provision increase was driven by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose their fiscal year 2024 income tax expense, effective tax rate, and the primary drivers behind these figures relative to the statutory rate. NVIDIA reported an income tax expense of $4.1 billion and an effective rate of 12.0%, noting the rate was lower than the 21% U.S. federal statutory rate due to benefits from the FDII deduction, stock-based compensation, and U.S. federal research tax credits. In contrast, AMD reported a significantly smaller income tax provision of $381 million and a higher effective tax rate of 19% for 2024. While NVIDIA's rate was depressed by specific statutory deductions, AMD's 2024 provision increased compared to 2023 primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.

sentences.text: We recognized income tax expense of $4.1 billion for fiscal year 2024 and income tax benefit of $187 million for fiscal year 2023.
Income tax as a percentage of income before income tax was an expense of 12.0% for fiscal year 2024 and a benefit of 4.5% for fiscal year 2023.

Our effective tax rates for fiscal years 2024 and 2023 were lower than the U.S. federal statutory rate of 21% due primarily to tax benefits from the FDII deduction, stock-based compensation and the U.S. federal research tax credit.
We recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 and an income tax benefit of $346 million in 2023, representing effective tax rates of 19% and (68%), respectively.
The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
